card: Defers MuSig2 secret nonce allocation until generation completes and rejects partial signature creation when given an uninitialized nonce. Previously, MuSig2SecNonce allocated memory in its constructor, causing IsValid() to report true before a nonce was generated and risking a crash in libsecp256k1 if partial signing was invoked. A regression test for the secnonce lifecycle is included.
evidence: Author description: "secp256k1_musig_partial_sign could be reached with an uninitialized secp256k1_musig_secnonce causing libsecp to crash."
problem: MuSig2SecNonce pre-allocated memory upon instantiation, causing IsValid() to return true before any secret nonce had been generated. If partial signing was attempted with such a nonce, uninitialized memory was passed to secp256k1_musig_partial_sign, which could crash the process via libsecp assertions.
summary: Defers allocation of the underlying secret nonce in MuSig2SecNonce until nonce generation succeeds, and verifies its validity before computing a partial signature. This ensures uninitialized nonces are flagged as invalid and cannot be passed to libsecp256k1.
